theme: Light mode as default, matching editorial travel magazine aesthetics. Backgrounds rely heavily on Warm Ivory and Sand. No dark mode required for editorial style.

colors.usage_ratios: 70% Warm Ivory, 15% Sand, 10% White/Charcoal/Deep Coffee (text/footer), 5% Soft Coral (accent)
colors.rules: AVOID cheap gradients. AVOID turquoise. AVOID generic beach colors. Stick to earthy, sophisticated, organic contrast.

typography.guidelines: Headlines must feel editorial and luxurious (light weights, italics for emphasis). Body text should be extremely legible. Overlines and labels use wide tracking. Never center paragraphs; only center headings if intentionally symmetrical.

spacing.system: Tailwind spacing scale with exaggerated gaps for luxury feel.
spacing.philosophy: Generous whitespace. Let the content breathe. Luxury = restraint and space.

layouts.philosophy: Editorial, asymmetrical, and overlapping. The Bento grid but with varied proportions. Image-led blocks.
layouts.grids: Use The Swiss Grid. 12-column layouts where images span 7 cols and text spans 4. High-density grid only for booking form.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped, bg-[#C98272] text-white, hover:bg-[#b07060] transition-colors. Sharp tracking.
buttons.secondary: Outline button with 1px border-[#DCCBB5], text-[#3A2C25], hover:bg-[#DCCBB5]/30. Pill-shaped.

cards.property_card: No visible border. Background #F7F3EC or White. Image takes up 70% of card height, masked in an elegant arch or standard subtle rounded corners (rounded-lg or rounded-xl). Soft, diffuse ambient shadow only on hover.
cards.blog_card: Cardless. Image with 24px bottom gap, followed by a wide-tracked date, then Cormorant heading.

nav.style: Sticky, glassmorphism (bg-[#F7F3EC]/80 backdrop-blur-xl). Minimal borders. Logo centered, links on left, BOOK DIRECT button on right.

forms.inputs: Underline only (border-b border-[#DCCBB5]) with 0px radius, or ultra-minimal boxes. Floating labels for premium feel.

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling for premium physical weight and momentum.
motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic full-viewport reveal. Line-by-line masked text reveal using framer-motion (y: '100%' to '0%' with overflow-hidden on parent).
motion.parallax: Subtle framer-motion useScroll on hero image (scale 1.1 to 1.0) and section images translating slightly on Y axis.
motion.hover: Images subtly scale up (1.03) with long transition (0.6s ease). Buttons get slight lift (-translate-y-0.5).
motion.marquee: Slow, editorial marquee for text like 'CURATED STAYS • HISTORIC CENTER • LUXURY LIVING'. Cormorant Garamond, italic, huge text.

imagery_art_direction.guidelines: Spotlight/clipped frames treatment. Large full-width photography for hero. Arch masks or staggered rectangular overlapping for gallery. AVOID palm-tree cliches. DO use architectural details, coffee culture, historic interiors.

sections_art_direction.hero: Kinetic full-viewport. Background image with 30% deep coffee overlay. Line-by-line masked text reveal for 'STAY WHERE CARTAGENA COMES ALIVE'.
sections_art_direction.brand_intro: Editorial two-column layout. Massive Cormorant quote on the left. Delicate Inter body text on the right. Generous padding (py-32).
sections_art_direction.the_collection: Tabs for Historic Center vs Manga. Large editorial property cards. Hover state pushes image scale and reveals direct booking link.
sections_art_direction.premium_feature: Immersive section spanning full width. Parallax scroll on a stunning interior shot. 'The Coral Standard'.
sections_art_direction.why_stay_coral: 4 feature blocks arranged in an asymmetric bento grid. Use icons sparingly; rely on beautiful typography (Overline + Heading).
sections_art_direction.cartagena_editorial: 4-column overlapping image grid (offset top margins) showcasing local culture. Cinematic.
sections_art_direction.reviews: Minimalist carousel. No borders. Quotes in italic Cormorant, huge text.
sections_art_direction.direct_booking_conversion: Solid #DCCBB5 (Sand) background section. Centralized strong CTA.
sections_art_direction.footer: Charcoal background (#252525) with Ivory text. Massive 'STAY CORAL' typography across the bottom.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface with content underneath it.
Limit animations to scroll reveals, parallax, and micro-interactions on hover. Do not over-animate.
Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA standards, especially for white text over imagery.
Responsive behavior must be impeccable; on mobile, text scales down elegantly and grid shifts to single column with ample padding.
Use Shadcn primitives minimally and customize aggressively to hide default Vercel/Bootstrap appearances.
Apply optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
No generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
